mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO TBL_SEAL_OPERATION_LOG ( SEAL_ID, SEAL_CODE, SEAL_NAME, OPERATION_TYPE, OPERATION_DESC, OPERATION_REASON, OPERATOR_ID, OPERATOR_NAME, OPERATION_TIME, IP_ADDRESS, OPERATION_RESULT, ERROR_MESSAGE, ORG_ID, CREATE_TIME ) VALUES
( #{log.sealId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.sealCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.sealName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operationType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operationDesc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operationReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operatorId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operatorName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operationTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{log.ipAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.operationResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.orgId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT CONFIG_ID, SEAL_ID, SECURITY_LEVEL, ALLOWED_USERS, ALLOWED_DEPTS, USAGE_START_TIME, USAGE_END_TIME, MAX_DAILY_USAGE, REQUIRE_APPROVAL, APPROVAL_USERS, IS_ENABLED, REMARKS, ORG_ID, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER FROM TBL_SEAL_SECURITY_CONFIG WHERE SEAL_ID = #{sealId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN OPERATION_TYPE = 'LOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalLocks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN OPERATION_TYPE = 'UNLOCK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalUnlocks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN OPERATION_TYPE = 'CONFIG' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalConfigChanges, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN OPERATION_RESULT = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalSuccess, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN OPERATION_RESULT = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalFails, COUNT(DISTINCT OPERATOR_ID) as uniqueOperators FROM TBL_SEAL_OPERATION_LOG
AND SEAL_ID = #{sealId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
